description: C&C Reloaded Final Fortress: Wings of Faith, five factions, independent progression. Native gameplay review pending.

perks.description: Three early, low-cost ranks give Einstein's Lab +25% / +50% / +100% maximum health for the whole run (1,500 / 1,800 / 2,400 HP). Emergency repair restores the upgraded maximum; the shared objective bonus does not stack per friendly house.
Automatically restore Einstein's Lab to full health once per run when it falls below 35% health (C&C Reloaded's native red-health threshold). One repair shared by the whole coalition.

Ten permanent ranks improve the one-use emergency squad from 4 faction units to 25, adding advanced troops, artillery, heavy and special units. Rank 9 arrives Veteran; rank 10 arrives Elite. Activates below 50% Lab health with 10 seconds of Lab-only Iron Curtain. Shared host rank in co-op; separate from periodic reinforcements.
Six ranks: +2,000 starting credits per rank, up to +12,000.
5% shorter production time per rank for infantry, vehicles/naval, aircraft, buildings and defenses; up to 25%.

Automatically deposit 1,000 credits per rank every 300 in-game seconds, up to 4,000 at rank 4. First payment after 5 minutes. Each human uses their own enabled rank; AI helpers share the host rank. No crates or collection.
Raise positive special-building limits by 1 per rank, up to +3. Does not unlock buildings or change unit limits.
Infantry, vehicles, ships and aircraft cost 5% less per rank, up to 25% at rank 5. Purchased separately from Cheaper Construction.
Buildings and defenses cost 5% less per rank, up to 25% at rank 5.

Eight ranks of mixed faction starting armies. Later ranks retain support infantry and add specialist armor, faction heroes, heavy aircraft and additional advanced roles, within the 15-unit staging area.
Rank 1: Veteran starting army. Rank 2: Elite, the highest veterancy. If Starting army is disabled, receive two faction infantry at the purchased veterancy instead.

Start with cumulative faction buildings: power plant, barracks, refinery with harvester, radar, then war factory. Higher ranks include extra native power plants where needed so every friendly base starts with spare power, independently of Starting defenses.
Eight of each unlocked faction defense form a complete perimeter around every friendly base, matching enemy fortification density. Each rank adds another full ring and enough native power plants.
All existing and subsequently built defenses start veteran.
Six ranks: +10% defense damage, fire rate and range per rank, up to +60%.
Six ranks: +5% unit health, damage and fire rate per rank, up to +30%. Applies only to player/allied copies.
Six ranks: +5% unit health, damage and fire rate per rank, up to +30%. Applies only to player/allied copies.
Six ranks: +5% unit health, damage and fire rate per rank, up to +30%. Applies only to player/allied copies.
Three cumulative ranks grant independent, native faction support powers. See Rank effects for the selected faction.
Rank 1 unlocks the faction secondary power; rank 2 adds its offensive superweapon. Both repeat independently from normal technology powers.
Increase power output from starting generators and all generators built during the run. Friendly helpers share the bonus. Each rank adds 25%, up to +150%.

Improve every enabled perk support power and faction superweapon. Each rank adds supported Grid/Shop buffs, including scouting sight, duration, payload and effect area. Existing capability caps apply; this perk does not unlock powers.
Reveal the entire map immediately.
One normal allied skirmish AI per rank, up to two. Same faction and enabled perks as the player.

Unlock one configured bonus unit per rank beyond the native faction roster. Uses the ordinary faction war factory; unique-unit limits still apply. These explicit perk unlocks are separate from captured Secret Lab rewards.

Twelve ranks of mixed faction reinforcements every five minutes. Support infantry arrive from rank 1; later ranks add specialist armor, heavy aircraft and more advanced roles. Rank 7 is Veteran, rank 8 onward Elite, with a shared 90-unit living cap.
Eligible units and defenses heal automatically, including rookies. Existing stronger healing is preserved.
Increase eligible unit/defense sight and enable supported cloak sensors.
Raise positive live-unit limits on eligible heroes and unlocked special units. Does not unlock new types.
